column1: # Known-vulnerable version ranges for network services, matched automatically by the ftp, smb
# and http detectors. min/max are an INCLUSIVE version range; leave either blank for open-ended
# ("everything up to max", or "min and later"). Keyed on the product name the detector reports
# (lowercase): vsftpd, proftpd, pure-ftpd, samba, apache, nginx, php, openssl, ...
# Ranges follow upstream/mainline. Distributions backport fixes, so a version inside a range is
# a lead to confirm (check the exact package build), not a guarantee. Add rows freely.

column6: description
Backdoored release: a username ending in ":)" opens a root shell on port 6200. Instant root, no auth.
mod_copy SITE CPFR/CPTO lets an unauthenticated user copy files anywhere - stage a web shell and get RCE.
Pre-auth stack overflow (sreplace) - remote code execution.
FTP command handling overflow in older 1.2.x.
Glob-expansion resource exhaustion / older pure-ftpd hardening issues; upgrade.
SambaCry: a writable share plus is_known_pipename() loads an attacker .so and runs it as root. Fixed in 4.6.4/4.5.10/4.4.14.
VFS fruit module out-of-bounds heap read/write - RCE as the smbd process (often root). Fixed in 4.15.5/4.14.12/4.13.17.
Username map script command injection - pre-auth RCE as root when that option is set.
Path-traversal that reads files outside DocumentRoot and, with mod_cgi, runs commands. 2.4.49 only.
Incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773 - traversal and RCE return in 2.4.50. Fixed in 2.4.51.
Local privilege escalation via the scoreboard ("Carpe Diem") - a worker gets root on the host.
Optionsbleed: memory disclosure via OPTIONS on .htaccess-limited resources.
Integer overflow in the range filter leaks memory (cached response contents) to a remote user.
Chunked-transfer stack overflow - remote code execution / DoS.
php-cgi argument injection: a query string of "?-s"/"?-d ..." runs code. End-to-end RCE on old php-cgi.
PHP 5.x is end-of-life and unpatched upstream. Treat any 5.x as carrying unfixed bugs; enumerate the exact version and check searchsploit.
PHP 7.x is end-of-life upstream. Confirm the distro is still backporting security fixes for this build.
Heartbleed: a malformed TLS heartbeat reads up to 64KB of process memory - keys, sessions, credentials.
Exposure to POODLE-era SSLv3 downgrade; disable SSLv3.
Ghostcat: the AJP connector (usually 8009) reads and can execute application files. Also 7.x/8.5.x.
Ghostcat on the 8.5.x line - AJP file read/RCE. Fixed in 8.5.51.
Older lighttpd mod_* issues; upgrade to a current 1.4.x.
Return of the Wizard: remote command execution as root via a crafted recipient. Patch immediately.
Backdoored/parameter-injection RCE in the password-reset feature - unauthenticated root.
